SAUDI OIL PIPELINE COULD BE DOWN FOR WEEKS

Saudi Arabia’s East-West oil pipeline could remain largely offline for 3–5 weeks following last week’s drone attack, AP reports.

The pipeline can carry up to 7 million barrels per day to the Red Sea, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz.

FED HIKE BECOMES THE BASE CASE

Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan now expect a 25bp Fed hike this week after hotter inflation and surging oil.

Kalshi puts the odds of a 25bp hike at 80%, while broader markets price around 87%.

JPMorgan expects another hike in December.
